assets.title: Railway Maintenance Workbench Wagon
assets.description: Original static railway maintenance wagon with a fixed rear workbench attached through four legs to a broad deck. Two genuinely open-front storage compartments have a solid shelf, side walls, divider and back. A rear toolboard holds a recognisable fixed hammer, open-jaw spanner and screwdriver on solid mounts; the forward deck remains visibly open as a work area. The tabletop is clear and every component has a physical static support path. Metres, source Z up, long axis Y; flange-bottom origin. Four tread centres X plus/minus .54 m, Y plus/minus .76 m; local tread bottom Z=.04 m. Place at Z=.16 m on the original 1.00 m clear-gauge track with head top Z=.20 m. Four solid PBR materials, named editable components, no external source dependency. This work station is different from the existing hand-push toolbox trolley and empty freight flatbed. Static visual prop only; no driving, braking, lifting, animated wheels, tool operation, dynamic coupling, human occupancy, load capacity, physics, engineering, railway safety or regulatory certification.
